works.title: Becoming Chairs
works.description: An XR work in development in which participants take the position of an everyday chair: stillness, load, wear and orientation replace the chair's ordinary availability for use.
works.description_zh: 一件开发中的 XR 作品：参与者处在一把日常椅子的位置上，以静止、承重、磨损与朝向，取代椅子平日“随时可用”的状态。
works.idea_en: Affordance estrangement: detach an object from its expected action so that its dependencies, resistances and material history become perceptible — not to feel what a chair feels.
works.idea_zh: 可供性陌生化：让物脱离它被期待的用途，使它的依存、阻力与物质历史变得可感知——而不是去感受椅子的感受。
works.method: XR stillness, altered affordances, spatial persistence and restrained interaction interrupt habitual use of the chair (details in development).
works.method_zh: 以 XR 中的静止、被改变的可供性、空间持续性与克制的交互，打断人对椅子的习惯性使用（细节仍在开发中）。

works.title: Be the Creek
works.description: An XR work in development in which participants experience flow, duration and relation as a creek rather than as a visitor standing beside one.
works.description_zh: 一件开发中的 XR 作品：参与者以一条溪流的方式体验流动、时长与关系，而不是站在溪边的访客。
works.idea_en: Becoming water is a change of tempo and extent: flow and duration, not a creature's point of view.
works.idea_zh: 成为水，是节奏与尺度的改变：是流动与时长，而不是某个生物的视角。
works.method: Mixed-reality embodiment of flow, duration and relation (details in development).
works.method_zh: 以混合现实具身呈现流动、时长与关系（细节仍在开发中）。

works.title: Making Kin with Creek as Fish
works.description: An XR work in development that remaps the participant's body to approach current, shelter, sensing and watershed infrastructure through a fish's relation to its creek.
works.description_zh: 一件开发中的 XR 作品：重新映射参与者的身体，借一条鱼与溪流的关系去接近水流、庇护、感知与流域基础设施。
works.idea_en: Empathy turned from possession (feeling what a fish feels) toward response-ability within a shared, uneven watershed.
works.idea_zh: 把共情从“占有”（感受鱼的感受）转向在共享而不均等的流域中的回应能力。
works.method: XR body remapping for current, shelter and sensing in a fish–creek relation (details in development).
works.method_zh: 以 XR 身体重映射呈现鱼与溪流关系中的水流、庇护与感知（细节仍在开发中）。
